name: robot
description: Call the robot API of the role bound to this session. For a new request omit the outer call_id; the host generates it and returns it as call_id. For job, put the original action's ID in data.call_id. To retry an uncertain request, send its original call_id with the identical op and data. views selects the RGB images returned. Calls in one reply run in order, each after the previous one has returned; to move several arms at the same time, use one action_batch, or submit each action with wait:false and then wait_events.

call_id.description: Omit for a new request. To retry an uncertain request, use its original ID with the identical op and data.
